summary: Mercedes Factory Options (mb_options) integration passes end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases green — catalog registration (filtered by submission_id), FB-000156 mb_spec persisted (152 options, 59 with description, chassis 206, year 2024, fuel Petrol, headunit NTG 7, navi region Africa/Middle East), re-order returns 409, mb_options standalone PDF (%PDF stub) serves OK, valuation.pdf renders and text-extracts the 'FACTORY FITTED' section together with W206, NTG 7, Africa/Middle East and SA codes 250A/250/251A/335B/675L/818U/JRE/JRJ/I35. Make guard fires 400 on non-Mercedes for mb_options (and still fires for bmw_options / landrover_osh regression). Frontend (Expo mobile web, 390x844): dealer dave@fourbuy.co.za on FB-000156 sees 'Mercedes Factory Options · R20 · DELIVERED · VIEW'. Tapping VIEW opens the report modal with the exact caption '152 factory-fitted options · VIN W1K2060872R185836 · Chassis W206 · 2024 · Petrol · Head Unit NTG 7' followed by the scrollable SA-code list (250A, 251A, 251B, 2S0, 31N, 335B, 675L, 6XXL, 818U, 84P, F206…). BMW/JLR rows correctly hidden on this vehicle. On the VW FB-000155 the Mercedes/BMW/JLR rows are all hidden — only Lightstone, CarVertical, Kredo VIN and CarTrust are offered. No regressions detected.

critical_code_review_comments: mbtools_client.py normalises `series` to the raw chassis digits (e.g. '206'). ReportResultBody prefixes 'W' at render time (`Chassis W${data.series}`) which produces 'W206' correctly, but be aware that if the raw ever comes through as 'W206' already the UI will read 'WW206'. Consider normalising once in the client.
The `/api/reports/catalog` endpoint hides make-restricted reports when `submission_id` is not supplied — this is by design but easy to mistake for a bug. Documented in test.
